$comment: Fleet registry for the /orchestrate skill. Committed: the fleet shape is a project fact.
Secrets never live here. SSH uses key auth resolved by the OS agent; no passwords, no
connection strings. 'repo' is that machine's checkout path, not this machine's.
Paths use forward slashes - .NET, pwsh, and git all accept them on Windows, and it keeps
this file free of backslash-escaping bugs.
Hostnames do NOT indicate form factor. Windows auto-names most PCs DESKTOP-XXXXXXX;
box3 reports DESKTOP-F5LK8MA but is physically a laptop (PCSystemType=Mobile, internal
battery). Recorded here so nobody re-derives it from the name and gets it wrong.
local  - same machine as the orchestrator. Bash/pwsh directly.
ssh    - headless. `ssh <target> claude -p ...`. Structured JSON back. Needs sshd + key auth.
rc     - Remote Control. That box runs `claude --remote-control`, signed into the same
Anthropic account; drive it with SendMessage, not with a shell. rcSessionName is
a HINT ONLY - the name changes every time the session restarts, so always confirm
against a live ListAgents before dispatching.
enabled:false means the transport is declared but not yet provisioned. /orchestrate must
refuse to dispatch to it and say which setup step is missing - never silently fall back.

machines.notes: Orchestrator host. The ONLY machine with XAMPP/MariaDB 10.4.32, so every card touching the database, a migration, or the running API belongs here (ADR-013 pins the three DB identities to this host).

PROVISIONED 2026-08-23. bootstrap-worker-machine.ps1 returned READY with no failing rows; L4 pre-commit hook installed by that run (a clone does not carry .git/hooks). Session restarted inside the checkout on 05d73d6 with the project CLAUDE.md loaded - verified, not assumed. SDK 10.0.301 side-by-side with 10.0.400. No XAMPP/MariaDB by design: every card touching the database, a migration, or the running API belongs on box1 (ADR-013). Git credential cached by a one-time interactive sign-in at the machine; an RC session has no TTY and can never establish one itself.

PROVISIONED 2026-08-23, same path as box2: READY with no failing rows, L4 pre-commit hook installed, session restarted inside the checkout on 05d73d6 with CLAUDE.md loaded. PCSystemType=2 (Mobile) - physically a LAPTOP despite the DESKTOP- hostname; read formFactor from here, never from the name. 57.8 GB free is the tightest box in the fleet - place disk-heavy work elsewhere.
